plan.notes: Source: official San Jacinto College Academic Catalog (current catalog; page footer reads 'San Jacinto College 2026-2027'), 'Computer Science, Associate of Science' program page: https://publications.sanjac.edu/areas-study/science-technology-engineering-math/computer-science-as/ — 'Plan of Study' grid (intended for students who do not yet know their transfer university). Named courses (ENGL 1301, EDUC 1100, COSC 1436, ENGL 1302 or ENGL 2311, COSC 1437, GOVT 2305, GOVT 2306), term credit totals (14 / 16 / 14 / 16), the 60-credit total, and the Transfer Path course list are transcribed verbatim from the 2026-2027 page. The current page's grid renders category rows as interactive core-selection dropdowns with no extractable text, so their labels were taken from the official 2025-2026 plan-of-study PDF for the identical grid (same named courses in the same positions, same term credits, same transfer-path list): https://publications.sanjac.edu/previous-catalogs/2025-2026/areas-study/science-technology-engineering-math/computer-science-as/computer-science-as_planofstudytext.pdf. Category-slot labels: 'Transfer Path Courses (see list below)' (3/3/4 SCH), American History (3/3), Social and Behavioral Sciences (3), Life and Physical Science (Natural Science) lecture and lab (4/4), Creative Arts (Fine Arts) (3), Language Philosophy and Culture (Humanities) (3), Mathematics (3), Component Area Option (3). CREDIT VERIFICATION: 14+16+14+16 = 60, matching the catalog's stated Total Credits 60; core slots sum to 42 SCH (the catalog's Core Curriculum requirement incl. EDUC 1100), major/transfer slots sum to 18 SCH (COSC 1436 + COSC 1437 + 10 SCH of transfer-path selections = 8+10 = 18), matching the catalog's 42 + 18 structure. CAVEATS: (1) The plan grid publishes no course-level prerequisites, so all prereq fields are empty — do not assume sequencing beyond the published order. (2) Students who know their transfer university should use the official Transfer Plans (MAPs) instead — the page lists UH Main and UHCL Computer Science BS full-time/part-time maps. (3) For math/science majors the catalog excludes MATH 1324, MATH 1325, MATH 1332 and non-major science lectures (BIOL 1308/1309, CHEM 1305, GEOL 1301, BIOL 2301/2302) from degree requirements; representative math/science options here reflect the major-appropriate choices. (4) Co-enrollment in the science lab is required with the science lecture. Speak to a San Jacinto advisor; transfer-institution requirements may differ.

courses.choice_note: Transfer Path Courses — select from the official Transfer Path list for a total of 10 SCH across this slot and slots s2-4 (3 SCH) and s3-3 (4 SCH): COSC 2436 Programming Fundamentals III, COSC 2325 Computer Organization, MATH 2413 Calculus I, MATH 2414 Calculus II, PHYS 2325 + PHYS 2125 University Physics I lecture/lab, PHYS 2326 + PHYS 2126 University Physics II lecture/lab. The transfer path requires 18 SCH total (COSC 1436 + COSC 1437 + at least 6 SCH from the list + remaining hours per the transfer institution).
